• Strong numerical and analytical ability with a high level of attention to detail.
• Strong bias for action.
• A practical and structured approach to finding university data rather than relying on a single source.

• Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, filters, sorting, Pivot Tables and data cleaning.
• Ability to work with large datasets and manage multiple universities/programs simultaneously.
• Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams and university stakeholders.

The information managed by this role directly supports university discovery, student and partner decision-making, internal operations and digital experiences. • A role with direct impact on the quality of information available to students, partners and internal teams.
